dogecoin.text: My #dogecoin is doing well. I won't make the same mistake & sell too early. I'm not cashing out until it hits $1 a coin at least!

In hindsight, I shouldn't have sold my original 27K #Dogecoins during the 1st rise in price. Had I still owned them, I'd be up over $3.3K now! Glad that I had enough sense to rebuy 9K coins later. My boy sold his #dogecoin at $2.4K during the 2nd wave. I bet he's kicking himself.
#Fact Had you invested $28 into #Dogecoin last summer, & waited until NOW to sell, you would have made a profit of over $3,000!
